caption: The drawing depicts a single pottery pitcher positioned upright in the center of the composition, shown against a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is bulbous in shape with a rounded, wide body that narrows towards the top, forming a short neck and a slightly flared rim. The rim has a purple-red coloration while the main body of the pitcher is a warm brown color with subtle variations and small dark spots, suggesting a natural earthenware or clay material. The pitcher features a curved handle attached from the top of the neck to the shoulder of the body, consistent in color with the body. The interior of the pitcher’s mouth is visible and has a yellow-brown tone with the same purple-red coloring at the edge. There are no additional objects or decorations, and the focus remains solely on the pitcher. The artwork appears to be a detailed, realistic illustration with shadowing present beneath the pitcher. There are faint signatures and a scale notation written in pencil at the bottom of the drawing.
title: Earthen Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
